g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
hydromodpy.analysis.batch.config.RegionalLabClusterRuleConfig
One explicit cluster enrichment rule applied on top of the site catalog.

hydromodpy.analysis.batch.config.RegionalLabConfig
Validated top-level configuration for one regional-lab run.

hydromodpy.analysis.batch.config.RegionalLabRecipeConfig
One recipe expanded across selected sites.

hydromodpy.analysis.capability_gallery.CapabilityGalleryConfig
Optional publication target for stable, versionable run figures.

hydromodpy.analysis.comparison.config.ComparisonFineRaster
Optional common regular-grid rasterization for map comparisons.

hydromodpy.analysis.comparison.config.ComparisonObservable
One quantity of interest extracted from each simulation run folder.

hydromodpy.analysis.comparison.experiment_config.ComparisonAuditConfig
Post-run equivalence policy for child simulations.

hydromodpy.analysis.comparison.experiment_config.ComparisonExecutionConfig
How comparison child simulations are executed.

hydromodpy.analysis.comparison.experiment_config.ComparisonSimulationConfig
One generated child simulation in a comparison experiment.

hydromodpy.analysis.config.AnalysisConfig
Hub aggregating every post-simulation analysis sub-section.
Each field is optional: enabling ``[analysis.batch]`` triggers the regional-lab launcher, ``[analysis.capability_gallery]`` selects figures for the versionable gallery, and ``[analysis.comparison]`` drives the comparison launcher.
